source.verse_hash_method: SHA-256 of exact original XML verse substrings including written/read and other notes; no normalized reconstruction.
source.public_versification_note: Exact source records mapped to established public labels; mapping is recorded for every verse and verified against source KJV annotations. Daniel, Hosea, Joel, Jonah, Micah, and Nahum have chapter-boundary differences.

key_decisions.decision: Makes the feminine addressees clear while retaining the harsh cattle insult and exploitation.
Preserves oath, captivity, and both hook terms; alternative containers noted.
Keeps individual female captives and the uncertain destination rather than replacing it with a known location.
Retains the sarcasm and literal three days rather than harmonizing to legal three-year tithes.
Keeps leavened offering and ostentatious proclamation without smoothing the irony.
Retains creation, disclosure, darkness, and heights; notes ambiguity of whose thought is disclosed.
